_readme: Trusted Directory of official domains for frequently impersonated Israeli organizations. Only entries with verified=true can produce a 'matches official' verdict. Entries with verified=false are kept so lookalikes can still be caught, but a link to them is reported as 'can't verify' until someone confirms the domain from an official source.

orgs.source: National Cyber Directorate warning (JDN/Maariv coverage); Israel Hayom article naming israelpost.co.il as the official address
Walla (15.7.2025): the operator recommends checking debts only via carmeltunnels.co.il/bills or by calling *5424

gov.il service page 'Fines and administrative enforcement reports received from Israel Police'. gov.il is a general government site, so only this service path counts as official; police.gov.il was seen in search results but not yet confirmed from the police site itself
oref.org.il appears in an official municipal document; TO RE-CHECK directly on the Home Front Command site
